name: @heyloo/edge-functions
description: Supabase Edge Functions (Deno runtime) for Heyloo's voice hot path, webhooks, admin routing, queue workers, and scheduled jobs. See supabase/functions/BUILD_NOTES.md for the Deno/Node split this package.json exists to support: portable, dependency-injected business logic in _shared/**/*.ts and per-function handler.ts files is typechecked and unit-tested here under Node/Vitest; Deno-only entrypoints (index.ts, anything importing an `npm:`/`jsr:` specifier or touching the `Deno`/`EdgeRuntime` globals) are excluded from this package's tsconfig and are Deno's responsibility at deploy time (supabase/functions/deno.json).
